mechanics.author: Valkkin
mechanics.observation: The guide describes copying the highest base attack and ignoring battle buffs, with self eligible. It describes five stacks and refreshable duration.
mechanics.conflict: Local parsed note says selection uses final attack but copied quantity uses base attack. This is not the same rule as the guide. Do not route copy_from through generic final-attack ranking without resolving that difference.
mechanics.cpu_status: Pinned calculator has no atk_copy or copy_from execution branch. CPU equality alone would certify an omitted effect.
mechanics.independent_witness_needed: Two eligible allies with different base attack, then reverse their final attack rank using a buff. Both copied quantity and selected identity must be asserted.

mechanics.author: Valkkin
mechanics.observation: The guide explicitly selects highest base maximum HP, permits self, describes current HP gaining the copied amount and says a duration-only refresh does not heal again. Healing potency does not increase this HP gain.
mechanics.conflict: Local copy_from names use allies_top_hp:1. Ordinary HP target ranking may observe buffed maximum HP; copy selection needs an explicit basis. Reuse snapshot storage conventions without assuming identical refresh healing to max_hp_from_max_hp_pct.
mechanics.cpu_status: Pinned calculator has no hp_copy or copy_from execution branch.
mechanics.independent_witness_needed: Reverse base/final maximum-HP ranks, reduce recipient current HP, refresh before expiry and after expiry, and apply healing-potency bonuses. Assert source identity, max HP and current HP separately.

shared_design.identity: Selection basis, copied quantity basis and recipient are independent inputs, not character names.
shared_design.quantity: Base ATK/HP after owned equipment/stat assembly versus live buffed ATK/HP must be distinguished.
shared_design.lifetime: Define first activation, stack increment, capped refresh, source changes, expiry and source down/revival explicitly.
shared_design.reuse: Use shared lifecycle and per-instance state, common ranking/snapshot helpers, and parameterized ATK/HP witnesses. Existing maximum-HP snapshot activation conventions can be reused only where semantics match.
shared_design.evidence_limit: Community guide observations are useful independent evidence, not proof of every interaction or the current game patch. Preserve source conflict and seek reproduction before asserting all-game verification.

execution_gate: Finish existing v46 native/PTX squad verification before introducing the next mechanism.
